name: User Status Switch
description: An AJAX toggle to activate/block users on the people listing.
project_description:
User Status Switch provides a modern, AJAX-powered toggle switch for the Drupal People administration page. It allows site administrators to quickly activate or block users with a single click without reloading the page, significantly improving user management efficiency.

 Features 
 
 One-click Activate/Block : Toggle user status directly from the main People administration list (/admin/people). 
 AJAX-powered : Instant updates without page refreshes. 
 Premium Design : Includes sleek, animated toggle buttons with clear Active/Blocked states. 
 Zero-Configuration : Automatically integrates with the default Drupal "People" view upon installation. 
 Secure : Respects Drupal core permissions (administer users) and implements robust CSRF protection. 
 Modern & Lightweight : Built with Vanilla JavaScript for maximum compatibility with Drupal 10 and 11. 
 
 Post-Installation 
 
 Installation : Enable the module via the Extend menu or Drush. 
 Automatic Setup : The module automatically adds the "Quick Status" column to your People list. 
 Usage : Navigate to People (/admin/people) and use the switches to manage user access instantly. 
 
 Additional Requirements 
 Depends only on Drupal Core (User and Views modules).
